name: frame
title: Frame
description: The frame primitive: an enclosure plus composable border, rule, corner-mark and fill layers.

name: shape-frame
title: Shape Frame
description: A frame whose outline follows a shape: bevelled, notched, scooped or rounded corners and punched edges.

name: frame-effects
title: Frame Effects
description: Effect layers for a frame in plain CSS: a gradient line, a glow, and a beam of light that travels around the border.

name: frame-spotlight
title: Frame Spotlight
description: A light on the frame's line that follows the pointer, shared across every frame on the page.

name: frame-metal
title: Frame Metal
description: Liquid metal on the frame's line, drawn with WebGL, in chromatic, silver and gold.

name: section-grid
title: Section Grid
description: A grid whose cells share one line between them, with a mark on every crossing and columns that change at breakpoints.

name: bracket-frame
title: Bracket Frame
description: Corner brackets around a dashed border.

name: hatch-divider
title: Hatch Divider
description: A hatched band between two lines for separating page sections, with marks where it meets the page rails.

name: page-rails
title: Page Rails
description: The column a page is laid out in: a vertical rail down each side, optionally with a patterned gutter.

name: section-rule
title: Section Rule
description: A line between page sections that runs past the page rails, with a mark on each intersection.

name: ticket-frame
title: Ticket Frame
description: A ticket with rounded corners, a perforated line and a tear-off stub.

name: folder-frame
title: Folder Frame
description: A folder with a tab on its top edge and a sloping shoulder.

name: bubble-frame
title: Bubble Frame
description: A speech bubble: a rounded box with a tail on any edge.

name: edge-frame
title: Edge Frame
description: A frame with zigzag, wavy, scalloped or bitten edges, in a whole number of repeats.

name: beam-frame
title: Beam Frame
description: A quiet border with a light travelling around it.

name: glow-frame
title: Glow Frame
description: A gradient border with a halo of the same colours behind it.
